hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-black text-[#0F172A]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-[#0F172A]

layout.spacing_system: p-4, p-6, p-8 for dashboard cards. p-16, p-24 for landing page sections.

grid_system.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. Dense 'Control Room' style.
grid_system.landing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Asymmetric 'Bento' style for feature sections.

rtl_support.rules: Dashboard Sidebar must be on the right. Content flow right-to-left. Use dir='rtl' on body/html. Icons implying direction must be mirrored.

layout.radius: rounded-md or rounded-lg (max 8px). Avoid pill shapes to maintain an authoritative Swiss look.
layout.alignment: Left-aligned for LTR, Right-aligned for RTL. Financial numbers should ideally use tabular nums and right alignment in tables.

components.buttons: Solid primary color for main actions, stark white text. Lighter hover state. Always include data-testid.
components.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px border (border-slate-200), no shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-sm and -translate-y-[2px].
components.charts: Use Recharts (Shadcn charts). High contrast colors. Solid strokes. No gradient fills unless communicating volume.
components.navigation: Dashboard: Sidebar right (RTL). Landing Page: Glassmorphism sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, border-b border-slate-200/50).
components.tables: Dense, crisp borders (border-collapse). Monospace for IDs, amounts, and crypto addresses.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards and buttons using 'transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out'.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 2. Keep sizing consistent (w-5 h-5 for inline).

image_urls.description: Abstract white geometric lines for landing page hero background to give a clean, tech-forward vibe.
Tehran Milad Tower skyline to resonate with Iranian users, suitable for a localized feature section.
Modern phone displaying financial charts, representing the crypto/fintech aspect and mobile readiness.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize Tailwind with the exact color palette provided in 'brand_colors'. Do NOT use default blue/purple gradients.
2. Add 'Vazirmatn' and 'Outfit' fonts via Google Fonts or standard imports. Apply 'font-sans' correctly in tailwind config.
3. Build the dashboard layout mirroring standard LTR (sidebar on the right for RTL users). Ensure layout is responsive (mobile-first).
4. Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Tables, Dropdowns, Select, DatePicker, Charts) and customize their borders and radius to match max 8px.
5. Format all financial numbers clearly. Use monospace font (JetBrains Mono) for ledger values and crypto balances.
6. MUST add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) for testing. e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`.
7. Implement clear status indicators (Green for success, Red for pending/fail) in the Transaction History.
8. Landing page should feature a strong hero section using the 'hero_background' image, overlay with bg-white/40 (glassmorphism) if text contrast is needed.
